metadata.source_note: Complete source cited by EStG § 32(4), sentence 1, number 2(d). Expression date identifies the instrument, without asserting blanket applicability in 2025. Captures the entire 23-page EU act including annex, entire 15-page 2016 weltwärts guideline, or complete GMBl pages 77–80 within the retained 16-page official PDF. Temporary IJFD Covid provisions expressly expire on 31 May 2021. The 2016 weltwärts edition is the statutory reference; later programme revisions require separate temporal analysis. No manually edited legal body.
metadata.title: Verordnung (EU) 2021/888 — Europäisches Solidaritätskorps
